title: Automatic Differentiation with Constraints in Forward and Inverse Problems
abstract: arXiv:2610.27888v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Approximate solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs) on unstructured grids can be represented on a graph. Numerical optimization involving stiff evolutionary and static PDEs often requires solving a large system of equations, which can be treated as a constraint. In this work, we present a fully differentiable graph-based implicit solver that incorporates this constraint. We evaluate its performance across four key tasks: a) linear and nonlinear forward modeling of evolutionary and static problems, b) solving inverse problems to estimate equation coefficients, c) solving inverse problems to estimate the right-hand side, and d) learnable graph coarsening to accelerate forward modeling. The stability and differentiability of our solver enable significant reductions in the complexity of forward modeling while efficiently addressing related inverse problems. translated_title: 正向与逆问题中带约束的自动微分
translated_abstract: 非结构网格上偏微分方程（PDE）的近似解可以在图上进行表示。涉及刚性演化方程和静态PDE的数值优化通常需要求解大型方程组，这可以被处理为一种约束。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种完全可微的、基于图的隐式求解器，该求解器融合了这一约束。我们在四个关键任务上评估了其性能：a) 演化问题和静态问题的线性和非线性正向建模，b) 求解逆问题以估计方程系数，c) 求解逆问题以估计方程右端项，d) 可学习的图粗化以加速正向建模。我们求解器的稳定性和可微性使得正向建模的复杂度显著降低，同时能够高效地处理相关的逆问题。这些能力使其成为不同物理和工程领域中的强大工具。
tldr: 本文提出了一种完全可微的基于图的隐式求解器，将大型方程组求解作为约束融入自动微分框架，实现了高效的正向建模、系数与右端项估计等逆问题求解，并通过可学习图粗化加速计算。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a fully differentiable graph-based implicit solver that incorporates large equation systems as constraints, enabling efficient forward modeling, inverse problems for coefficient and right-hand-side estimation, and acceleration through learnable graph coarsening.
